status.value: Active work in progress. The maintainer reports 102,056 functions lifted to C++, all 140 imported functions resolved, a continuous frame loop and a D3D12-rendered Level 3 scene; the title-state machine remains stuck before full gameplay, seven of twelve HLE bridges are real, and roughly 10,000 TODOs remain. Windows x64 is the current target; Linux is planned.

status.value: Active research; the latest maintainer update is dated 2026-10-10.
